question_cn: 在局面分析中，如何快速找到消除保护的机会？
question_en: How can you quickly spot an opportunity to remove a defender?

options.text_cn: 找到对方最远离国王的棋子，它通常防守最薄弱
options.text_en: Find the enemy piece farthest from its king; it is usually the least protected

options.text_cn: 扫描对方每个有价值的目标，找出谁在保护它，再判断保护者能否被消灭或驱走
options.text_en: Check each valuable enemy target, identify its defender, then see whether that defender can be captured or driven away

options.text_cn: 先计算自己能发起多少次将军，能将军就有消除保护的机会
options.text_en: Count how many checks you can give; any checking move creates a chance to remove a defender

options.text_cn: 只看对方的后和车，它们是最常见的保护者
options.text_en: Look only at the enemy queen and rooks, since they are the most common defenders

explanation_cn: 识别消除保护的标准流程：①选定想要攻击的目标棋子；②追问「谁在保护这个目标？「；③评估能否消灭保护者（直接吃掉）、驱走保护者（献子强制移位）或牵制保护者（令其无法动弹）。任何兵种都可以充当保护者，不限于后和车——一个小兵守着关键格时同样是消除保护的目标。
explanation_en: First choose a valuable target, then ask what is defending it. Finally, check whether you can capture the defender, deflect it with a sacrifice, or pin it so it can no longer protect the target. Any piece, even a pawn, can be a key defender.
